 Human Resources Training for People's Schools in Bogor
 4th November 2026 19:27 GMT+7
 Several participants attended the human resources (HR) training for support staff of Sekolah Rakyat in Cibinong, Bogor Regency, West Java, Wednesday (4/11/2026). The Ministry of Social Affairs strengthened 800 HR personnel of Sekolah Rakyat through training in three groups of support staff, covering case management, security units, and the processing of Basic Education Data (Dapodik) to support educational, rehabilitation, and empowerment services. ANTARA FOTO/Yulius Satria WIjaya/wsj.
